channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: Wonder Juice Expands Wonder Green Line
item.description: Wonder Juice is growing its Wonder Green lineup with two new cold-pressed blends designed to support daily wellness and functional performance. Clean Green and Veg8 & Cayenne highlight how brands are pairing approachable flavors with nutrient-dense ingredients to meet evolving consumer expectations.

item.title: Culture Pop, Noah Kahan Launch Limited Soda
item.description: Culture Pop has teamed with artist Noah Kahan to release a limited-edition Sparkling Black Cherry soda supporting The Busyhead Project. The collaboration blends clean-label, functional soda with cause-driven branding, highlighting how partnerships can connect product launches with purpose.

item.title: Kraft Heinz Plans $600M Push Into R&D, Brand Support
item.description: Amid continued volume declines in center-store categories, Kraft Heinz is redirecting capital toward R&D, marketing and product superiority initiatives — signaling renewed emphasis on formulation upgrades and brand reinvestment heading into 2026.

item.title: OH SNAP! Adds Chil-lime Bites to Lineup
item.description: OH SNAP! is expanding its refrigerated snack portfolio with Chil-lime Bites, pairing chili heat with a bright lime finish. The launch reflects growing demand for bold, globally inspired flavors and signals the brand’s push to energize the better-for-you snacking space.

item.title: Circana Launches Attribute Marketplace
item.description: Circana has introduced its Attribute Marketplace, a new solution designed to simplify access to external datasets within its analytics ecosystem. The platform enables retailers and CPGs to layer in premium product attributes, supporting deeper insights, faster decision-making and innovation.

item.title: Stern-Wywiol Rebrands US Operations as SternMaid America
item.description: The reorganization consolidates blending, tolling and packaging services with a broader ingredient lineup spanning plant-based systems, vitamin premixes and functional blends — signaling closer integration of R&D, piloting and commercialization support for product developers.

item.title: Genius Gourmet Grows SKIPPY Protein Line
item.description: Genius Gourmet is building momentum with its SKIPPY-inspired protein snacks as distribution expands across grocery and convenience channels. The lineup blends nostalgic peanut butter flavor with protein-forward formats designed to meet modern snacking needs without sacrificing taste.

item.title: IFIC Survey Finds Fiber Knowledge Gap
item.description: A new IFIC Spotlight Survey shows that while interest in fiber is high, most Americans still fall short on intake and remain confused about where fiber comes from. The findings highlight an opportunity for clearer communication, better product cues and practical guidance as fiber gains renewed attention in wellness culture.

item.title: Red Baron, bibigo Launch Korean BBQ Pizza
item.description: CJ Schwan’s is pairing Red Baron and bibigo to introduce a Korean BBQ-style frozen pizza exclusive to Kroger. The collaboration reflects how brands are using global flavor mashups and limited-time offerings to drive freezer aisle excitement.

item.title: milkadamia Debuts Shelf-Stable Oat Milk Slices at Target
item.description: The thin, blend-able oat milk sheets point to growing interest in lightweight, ambient dairy alternatives that lower shipping costs and extend shelf life while maintaining customizable functionality.
